Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play outside. One day, she went on a walk with her mom and dad. It was very cold outside, and Lily started to shiver because she was cold and cold. 

Her mom told her that she should go inside and have a warm bath, but Lily didn't want to stop playing. She got a pile of toys and put them in the bathtub. Then she felt much better after playing outside with her toys.
